parsed.rationale: All five members — `AppleMusicService`, `BandcampService`, `SoundCloudService`, `SpotifyService`, and `YouTubeMusicService` — are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same package (`MusicShareKit`) with identical structural shape (`shared_field_count: 1`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact structural duplicates. Because they are type aliases rather than distinct classes, the duplication is almost certainly the result of each service aliasing the same underlying generic or concrete type without a unifying abstraction. Introducing a `MusicService` protocol (potentially with an associated type for per-service configuration) would give each service a distinct nominal identity while eliminating the repeated boilerplate alias pattern. No restraint markers are present on any record, so action is warranted.
